code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = None
    horizontal = False
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            split, horizontal = r, True
            break
    if split is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
                split, horizontal = c, False
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("No uniform separator")
    if horizontal:
        a, b = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
        if len(a) != len(b) or any(len(x) != len(y) for x, y in zip(a, b)):
            raise ValueError("Panels have different shapes")
    else:
        a = [row[:split] for row in grid]
        b = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
        if len(a[0]) != len(b[0]):
            raise ValueError("Panels have different shapes")
    shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    background = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if x == y else background for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
'''
